# ApplyAgent

> ApplyAgent is an AI job-application agent built for the Authorized to Act hackathon. It analyzes job descriptions, matches them to your skills and prepares applications, and you approve exactly what is sent and when.

Site: https://applyagent.kurtaxcel.com
Built by: [Kurt Axcel](https://www.kurtaxcel.com) (Kurt Axcel Peñano), a Filipino student builder who makes custom-built AI and web apps for businesses. Devpost: https://devpost.com/devkurtaxcel · All links: https://links.kurtaxcel.com
